presets.name: Maracas
presets.description: Gourd full of seeds: woody rattle, accented 'chk' on each reversal (STK Maraca)
presets.source: STK Maraca: 25 beans, systemDecay 0.999 (decay = 1/(44100*(1-0.999)) s), soundDecay 0.95, resonance 3200 Hz r 0.96, equalisation (1, -1, 0) (one-zero high-pass 'gourd'). Bead count raised to 400 for a denser rattle.

presets.name: Cabasa
presets.description: Steel bead chains scraping a ridged cylinder: dense, bright, raspy hiss (STK Cabasa)
presets.source: STK Cabasa: 512 beads, systemDecay 0.997 (decay = 1/(44100*(1-0.997)) s), soundDecay 0.96, resonance 3000 Hz r 0.7 (very broad), equalisation (1, -1, 0). Bead count raised to 3000.

presets.name: Shekere
presets.description: Gourd wrapped in a net of beads: crisp, airy, high rattle (STK Sekere)
presets.source: STK Sekere: 64 beans, systemDecay 0.999 (decay = 1/(44100*(1-0.999)) s), soundDecay 0.96, resonance 5500 Hz r 0.6, equalisation (1, 0, -1) (band-pass: zeros at DC and Nyquist). Bead count raised to 400.

presets.name: Egg shaker
presets.description: Small plastic egg with fine grains: bright, short, tight 'tsk' (derived from Maraca/Sekere)
presets.source: Not in STK. Derived from Maraca/Sekere: a small plastic shell (higher, less resonant body: 5200 Hz r 0.9 plus an 8000 Hz r 0.8 shell overtone), fine sand-like fill (40 grains in the original derivation, 250 here), shorter clicks (soundDecay 0.92 vs 0.95) and a short system decay (~15 ms: a small egg stops rattling almost immediately). High-pass (1, -1, 0) equalisation.

presets.name: Ganza
presets.description: Metal tube of steel shot: loud, metallic 'tch-tch' sizzle (derived from STK Tambourine/Sandpaper)
presets.source: Metal tube filled with shot; not in STK. Derived from STK Tambourine (fixed shell resonance 2300 Hz r 0.96 -> 2600 Hz tube body; jingle resonances 5600/8100 Hz r 0.99, randomly detuned +/-5 % per collision, Tambourine varyFactor 0.05) plus the broad Sandpaper/Sekere-style grit band (4500 Hz r 0.6) for the hiss of many small pellets. 128 objects in the original derivation (between Sekere and Cabasa; 800 here), soundDecay 0.96, systemDecay 0.9985 (Tambourine; decay = 1/(44100*(1-0.9985)) s). Band-pass (1, 0, -1) equalisation.

presets.name: Rainstick
presets.description: Turn it over and pebbles trickle down for seconds; shaking adds a rattle (tilt-driven)
presets.source: Not in STK. Tilt-driven grain flow (flow_shake_tau set; decay is the grain-flow time). Resonances follow STK Bamboo chimes (2800 Hz with 0.8x / 1.2x partners, varyFactor 0.2) but with a much lower pole radius (0.97 vs 0.995) so the pins 'tick' instead of ringing, plus STK Little Rocks' 9000 Hz r 0.843 band (varyFactor 0.18) for pebble grit.
